title: Swedenborg's visits to other planets

tellings.quote: >> 17th century Swedish mystic Emanuel Swedenborg you know saying he went to other planets and coming back

plain: The Swedish mystic Emanuel Swedenborg, whom Michels places in the 17th century, said he went to other planets and came back to tell about it. Michels mentions it in passing, without a source, as an older example of people claiming to travel beyond Earth by the mind.
